edges.reason: msg.sender is stored directly into the ERC20 _owner state variable at construction.
_msgSender() returns the untrusted msg.sender value.
transfer() uses _msgSender() as the sender of the token movement.
transferFrom() uses _msgSender() as the spender when decreasing allowance.
USET constructor assigns msg.sender into the ownership state variable.
Constructor writes the caller address into ownership.
Constructor sets _totalSupply to 6000000 * 10**18.
Constructor credits the entire supply to ownership inside _balances.
fallback/receive pass msg.sender into buy() as the beneficiary of purchased tokens.
Payable fallback invokes buy(msg.sender).
Payable receive invokes buy(msg.sender).
tokenSale constructor stores the supplied token address into token.
tokenSale _owner state variable is initialized from msg.sender.
transfer() delegates the balance mutation to _transfer().
transferFrom() delegates the balance mutation to _transfer().
transferFrom() calls _approve() to reduce the spender allowance.
approve() calls _approve() to set the allowance.
increaseAllowance() writes the new allowance through _approve().
decreaseAllowance() writes the new allowance through _approve().
increaseAllowance() uses SafeMath.add on the allowance.
decreaseAllowance() uses SafeMath.sub on the allowance.
transferFrom() uses SafeMath.sub to decrease the allowance.
_transfer() uses SafeMath.sub on the sender balance.
_transfer() uses SafeMath.add on the recipient balance.
_transfer() reads and writes the _balances mapping.
_approve() writes the _allowances mapping.
getLatestPrice() queries the priceFeed oracle contract.
Price depends on external oracle round data whose timestamp is never validated, creating a stale-price/timestamp dependency.
buy() calls getLatestPrice() to obtain the USD conversion rate.
buy() writes the oracle result into the weiUSD state variable before external calls.
buy() writes the computed amount into the amountOfTokens state variable.
buy() divides msg.value by weiUSD to compute unitPrice.
buy() multiplies unitPrice by 10**18 to compute amountOfTokens.
buy() forwards the received ETH through _forwardFunds().
_forwardFunds() performs an external ETH send to the wallet address.
_forwardFunds() reads the destination wallet state variable.
buy() performs an external token.transfer() call at the end of the function.
The external transfer targets the token contract stored in the token state variable.
_transfer() performs the balance subtraction that relies on SafeMath underflow checks.
safeTransfer() delegates the call to callOptionalReturn().
callOptionalReturn() verifies the token address is a contract via isContract().
callOptionalReturn() executes an arbitrary low-level call on the token address.
A malicious token can re-enter buy() from the external token.transfer() call.
The ETH send in _forwardFunds() can invoke a fallback/receive that re-enters tokenSale buy logic.
The low-level token call can re-enter SafeERC20.callOptionalReturn before state settlement.
